headline: Market closed for weekend; FII outflows and primary market activity in focus for upcoming session

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today, Sunday, 20 September 2026, for the weekend.
FPIs and FIIs have withdrawn over ₹20,000 crore from Indian equities in September amid global uncertainty.
Crude oil movements and West Asia developments are expected to impact market direction in the upcoming week.
Primary market activity remains robust with multiple IPOs lining up for launch.
whatHappening: Foreign portfolio investors pulled out ₹20,974 crore from Indian equities during September.
Six companies are lined up to raise ₹3,825 crore via initial public offerings.
Market analysts suggest Sensex and Nifty may find support in the week of September 21-25.
Paytm was highlighted among stock-specific trading triggers.
summary: The stock market is closed today for the weekend and reopens on Monday, September 21. Recent data shows strong FPI selling, with over ₹20,000 crore withdrawn in September amid global economic uncertainties. Meanwhile, primary market sentiment remains active with six companies planning IPOs worth ₹3,825 crore.
